newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai May CPI up 4.3 pct yr/yr - ministry.
newsitem.headline: Thai May CPI up 4.3 pct yr/yr - ministry.

text.p: The Thai consumer price index (CPI) rose 4.3 percent year-on-year in May against a 4.3 percent rise in April, the Commerce Ministry said on Monday.
The ministry said the 1990-based index rose to 138.8 in May from its 133.1 level in the same month a year ago.
The Thai Commerce Ministry issued the following economic indicators:
THAI CONSUMER PRICE May 97 April 97 May 96

NOTES: In the food and beverage category, rice and flour product prices surged 1.5 percent in May from April, meat, poultry and marine products gained 0.3 percent, but vegetable and fruit prices contracted 3.9 percent.

In the non-food group, prices of entertainment, reading and educational materials rose 3.0 percent in May from April, transport and communications expenses increased 0.6 percent, and clothing rose 1.2 percent month-on-month.
